API keys, sign-ins, the default model, conversations and long-term memory from the earlier Atom app on this phone. Only what is not imported yet. The import leaves the old files as they are; they are removed a week after an import that brought everything over.
Deletes the old app\'s files, including its unencrypted API keys. Your imported data stays.
Import first. Once the import has run, this deletes the old app\'s files, including its unencrypted API keys.
The import did not finish. Deleting the old app\'s files, including its unencrypted API keys, loses whatever was not imported yet.

This deletes the earlier Atom app\'s database (which holds its API keys unencrypted), its sign-in files, its settings file and saved secrets, and its keys in the Android Keystore. Its MCP servers, skill list and scheduled tasks, which Atom 4 does not import, are removed too, along with their saved tokens. Its memory file is deleted only once that memory is in Atom 4; otherwise it is kept, and you can delete it separately. Everything imported into Atom 4 stays, with its API keys encrypted in Atom 4\'s vault. This cannot be undone, and the import cannot be run again afterwards.
